observations.all_page_sweep: Every physical page from 1 through 58 was opened individually at original detail. No clipping, overflow, overlap, blank or unreadable page, broken glyph box, damaged formula, bad centering, or unsafe margin was found.
observations.title_and_front_matter: Physical page 1 is cleanly centered and legible; the title, subtitle, authorship, and source block remain safely inside the A4 page.
observations.terminology_headings: The section headings Aljabar-sigma, Ruang ukur, Ukuran luar dan konstruksi Caratheodory, Ukuran Lebesgue, Fungsi terukur, Definisi integral, Teorema-teorema konvergensi, and Subruang terukur render consistently and legibly.
observations.representative_diagram_and_math: The four labeled set diagrams on physical page 13 are crisp, aligned, unobstructed, and fully contained. Dense formulas and source notation throughout the reader remain readable and intact.
observations.section_transitions: Large whitespace on physical pages 7, 17, 30, 40, 50, and 55 is deliberate section-ending composition, not missing or truncated content. Mid-sentence page endings continue normally on the following page.
observations.s131_focus: Physical pages 56-58 received a separate detailed pass. Restriction and indicator notation, integrals, subscripts, tildes, and measure formulas are intact, and the page-58 footnote is fully visible inside the bottom margin.
observations.accessibility_caveat: Text extraction succeeds without replacement or NUL characters. Compatibility ligatures can require Unicode normalization for literal ASCII searching; this is a nonvisual search caveat rather than a rendering defect.

claim_limit: This receipt attests only to PDF visual QA of the exact identified bytes, with PDF metadata, font, image, and text-extraction sanity checks. It makes no claim about mathematical correctness, translation fidelity, source completeness, licensing conclusions, or publication readiness.
